metadata.title: The geometric combinatorics of $k$-shuffle braid groups
metadata.abstract: This paper is the first in a series of two which aims at introducing a new family of groups called $k$-shuffle braid groups, denoted $\mathcal{B}_{n}(k)$. These groups have two intrinsically related stories. They were first observed by Calegari in arXiv:2105.11265 by looking at spaces of complex monic polynomials of degree $n$ whose critical values lie in $\mathbb{C} \setminus \{1, e^{\frac{2\pi i}{k}}, \dots, e^{\frac{2\pi (k-1)}{k}}\}$. The $k$-shuffle braid groups are the fundamental groups of those spaces, which correspond geometrically to complements of $k$ translates of the discriminant variety. The second story starts from the poset of $k$-shuffle partitions, which were introduced by Drew Armstrong and explored in depth in his thesis arXiv:math/0611106 . In this paper, we focus on the combinatorial aspects of $k$-shuffle braid groups starting from the poset of $k$-shuffle non-crossing partitions. We build a CW-complex on which the groups act freely, properly discontinuously and cocompactly, which we show is CAT(0) for dimension up to 7. For higher dimension, we show that the CAT(0) property is implied by the conjecture of Brady and McCammond that the dual braid complex is CAT(0) ( arXiv:0909.4778 ).
metadata.comment: This is the first paper in a series of two, with the second one to be uploaded later in the week

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: shuffle 辫群的 CAT(0) 模型
analysis.workSummary: 从 k-shuffle 非交叉分划构造新群族的余紧自由 CW 作用模型，证明维数不超过七时 CAT(0)，更高维归约到 Brady–McCammond 的 dual braid complex 猜想。
analysis.breakthrough: 把判别式补空间的群与组合模型联系起来。
analysis.limitations: 仅低维 CAT(0) 已证，高维仍依赖猜想；本篇是系列首篇。 已补读 引言与 Theorem A/B。核对了 CAT(0) 的高维条件性：依赖 dual braid complex 的局部 CAT(0) 假设；尚未验证复形链接的全部曲率条件。
analysis.aiEvidence: 声明明确排除 AI 写作和数学内容，但承认仅用于文献搜索，仍属于明确披露。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28986v1 · PDF 第 3 页 Statement on AI usage

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。声明明确排除 AI 写作和数学内容，但承认仅用于文献搜索，仍属于明确披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何群论与配置空间拓扑的重要模型构造。
